msg: Hey! I got my Open Water certification 3 years ago but haven't dived since. I'm staying in Getsemaní for a week and would love to dive on two different days. What would you recommend and how much is it? Can I pay cash in dollars on the boat?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

A refresher is normally required after more than two years without diving, so I’d recommend starting with that before planning your dives. The price is the same in either currency; the currency depends on whether you’re Colombian or a resident of Colombia.

For two separate dive days, the certified-diver trip from Cartagena includes two dives and returns the same day. You can choose the dates in the booking calendar, but you’ll need to complete the refresher first.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)

You can’t pay the full amount in cash on the boat without booking. International guests book and pay online by card. Would you like help getting started with the refresher booking?

msg: Hey! I got my Open Water certification 3 years ago but haven't dived since. I'm staying in Getsemaní for a week and would love to dive on two different days. What would you recommend and how much is it? Can I pay cash in dollars on the boat?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

A refresher is normally required after more than two years without diving, so I’d recommend starting with the Dive Mini Course. It’s a one-day refresher, and you could then do a Fun Dives trip on another day. Both depart from Cartagena and return the same day.

The online price includes the standard online discount. I’m leaving the prices below as well.

Payment in dollars is made online through the booking link; cash payment on the boat isn’t available. The refresher is booked as the Dive Mini Course: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en  
Fun Dives booking: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)

Would you like to book these for two separate days?

msg: Yes, from Cartagena. I'm German by the way. So what's the plan, the refresher on day one and normal dives on day two? Does the refresher day include lunch too?
reply:
Yes, that’s a good plan: the refresher on day one, then certified Fun Dives on day two. Since it’s been three years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. Both days include lunch, and each is a day trip from Cartagena.

The refresher includes pool practice and one reef dive with a PADI instructor. The Fun Dives day includes two guided reef dives. For both, meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.; the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m., with arrival estimated around 4:15 p.m.

As a German guest, your prices are in USD. The online prices are $183 for the refresher and $178 for Fun Dives; regular prices are $204 and $197, respectively. The online discount is applied automatically when booking on our website.

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊

Today’s dive trip isn’t available to book—the boats leave in the morning, and same-day bookings aren’t possible. You can book for the next available day online; the system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before. Certified divers need to show their certification cards, either beforehand or on the day.

For two certified divers departing from Cartagena, the 1-day, 2-dive trip is **$178 USD or COP 630,000 per person online** (the 10% online discount is applied automatically). You can choose your date and number of people here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

Would you like to book for the next available day?

msg: Buenas tardes. Soy de Medellín, buzo certificado desde hace años, tengo 70 años y me operaron de la rodilla hace un año. Quiero bucear con mis nietos de 9 y 13 años. ¿Qué podemos hacer los tres y cuánto cuesta?
reply:
Buenas tardes. Para buzos certificados, la salida de 2 inmersiones es una linda opción para disfrutar juntos de las Islas del Rosario. Como eres de Medellín, te doy los valores en COP:

**Desde Cartagena**
- Salidas de Buceo — 2 inmersiones, 1 día: **630.000 COP online** o **700.000 COP normal**.
- Paquete de 3 inmersiones, 1 día (2 diurnas y 1 nocturna): **1.017.000 COP online** o **1.130.000 COP normal**.
- Paquete de 4 inmersiones, 2 días (4 diurnas): **1.154.000 COP online** o **1.282.000 COP normal**.

**Si ya están en las Islas del Rosario**
- Salidas de Buceo — 2 inmersiones, 1 día: **440.000 COP online** o **489.000 COP normal**.
- Paquete de 3 inmersiones, 1 día (2 diurnas y 1 nocturna): **665.000 COP online** o **739.000 COP normal**.
- Paquete de 4 inmersiones, 2 días (4 diurnas): **720.000 COP online** o **800.000 COP normal**.

La edad mínima para buceo certificado es **10 años**, así que tu nieto de 13 puede participar en una salida certificada. Para el de 9, está disponible **Bubble Makers**, para niños de 8 a 10 años, en piscina o aguas muy poco profundas (máximo 2 metros), con instructor PADI dedicado; no da certificación. Los detalles y la reserva de esa actividad los coordina un asesor.

Para la condición médica relacionada con tu operación, debe orientarte una persona del equipo; no puedo valorar si es seguro bucear en tu caso.

Para preguntas médicas específicas, es importante que hables con nuestro staff calificado para evaluar tu situación particular. Te paso ahora con alguien del equipo, que te escribe por aquí enseguida.

rag.query: Buenas tardes. Soy de Medellín, buzo certificado desde hace años, tengo 70 años y me operaron de la rodilla hace un año. Quiero bucear con mis nietos de 9 y 13 años. ¿Qué podemos hacer los tres y cuánto cuesta?
rag.answer:
¡Qué bonito plan para compartir con tus nietos! Para ti, la edad por sí sola no es un límite, pero por la operación de rodilla no puedo determinar si es seguro que bucees: eso debe revisarlo un profesional. ¿Quieres que te pase con un asesor del equipo para orientarte sobre tu caso?

Para los niños, el de 9 años puede hacer **Bubble Makers**, una experiencia en piscina o aguas muy poco profundas (máximo 2 m), con instructor PADI dedicado; no es una certificación. Cuesta **600.000 COP online o 667.000 COP normal**. El de 13 años puede hacer una salida de buceo si está certificado; si no, puede hacer el **Minicurso de Buceo**, desde los 10 años. Los menores deben ir acompañados por un padre o pariente responsable demostrable.

El precio depende de la actividad y de si salen desde Cartagena o ya están en las islas. ¿Desde dónde saldrían, y el de 13 años tiene certificación de buceo?

¡Qué bonito plan para compartir con tus nietos! Para ti, la edad por sí sola no es un límite, pero por la operación de rodilla no puedo determinar si es seguro que bucees: eso debe revisarlo un profesional de salud y el equipo de buceo.

Para tus nietos, el de 9 años puede hacer **Bubble Makers**, una experiencia en piscina o aguas muy poco profundas, hasta 2 m, con instructor dedicado. Cuesta **600.000 COP online o 667.000 COP normal**; el traslado, horario y almuerzo los confirma el equipo. El de 13 años puede hacer el **Minicurso de Buceo** desde Cartagena: **655.000 COP online o 727.000 COP normal**. Como ya eres buzo certificado, puedes hacer una salida de **2 inmersiones**: **630.000 COP online o 700.000 COP normal**. Los menores deben ir acompañados por un padre o pariente responsable demostrable.

Como son actividades distintas y tu caso requiere revisar la operación, ¿quieres que te pase con un asesor para que te ayude a coordinar el plan de los tres?

rag.query: Buenas tardes. Soy de Medellín, buzo certificado desde hace años, tengo 70 años y me operaron de la rodilla hace un año. Quiero bucear con mis nietos de 9 y 13 años. ¿Qué podemos hacer los tres y cuánto cuesta?
rag.answer:
Buenas tardes. Para buzos certificados, la edad mínima es de 10 años y no hay edad máxima. Tu nieto de 13 años puede participar en buceo certificado; el de 9 no alcanza la edad mínima para esa actividad, pero puede hacer Bubble Makers, disponible para niños de 8 a 10 años.

**Precios por persona:**
- **Desde Cartagena:** 2 inmersiones, 1 día: 630.000 COP online o 700.000 COP normal. También hay paquetes de 3 inmersiones (2 diurnas y 1 nocturna): 1.017.000 COP online o 1.130.000 COP normal; y de 4 inmersiones diurnas en 2 días: 1.154.000 COP online o 1.282.000 COP normal.
- **Si ya están en las Islas del Rosario:** 2 inmersiones, 1 día: 440.000 COP online o 489.000 COP normal. También hay paquetes de 3 inmersiones (2 diurnas y 1 nocturna): 665.000 COP online o 739.000 COP normal; y de 4 inmersiones diurnas en 2 días: 720.000 COP online o 800.000 COP normal.

Para Bubble Makers, el precio es **600.000 COP online o 667.000 COP normal desde Cartagena**, y **435.000 COP online o 484.000 COP normal si ya están en las islas**. Los detalles de traslado, horario y almuerzo los confirma el equipo.

msg: Hi, I'm Advanced Open Water certified, from London. I'm staying at a hotel on Isla Grande for 5 days. I'd like the 4-dive package over 2 days. How much and how do I book?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The 4-dive package over 2 days includes four daytime dives and is a great way to explore the reefs around Isla Grande. Since you’ll already be on the islands, you won’t need the Cartagena boat transfer; lunch isn’t included. Accommodation is booked separately with your hotel.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

I’m leaving the price options below. To book, please connect with a team advisor, as this package doesn’t have an online booking link.

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you like me to connect you?

msg: Buenas! Soy argentino, tengo Advanced de SSI con unas 40 inmersiones. Me interesa bucear con nitrox en las Islas del Rosario. Me sirve mi certificación SSI? Ustedes tienen nitrox?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Las Islas del Rosario son un lugar buenísimo para disfrutar varias inmersiones. Sí, tenemos tanques de Nitrox para buzos certificados en Nitrox; debes pedirlos al reservar.

Tu certificación Advanced de SSI acredita experiencia de buceo, pero para la **Especialidad PADI Nitrox** el requisito indicado es tener certificación PADI Open Water. No tengo confirmado si tu certificación SSI cumple ese requisito; ¿quieres que te pase con un asesor para que lo revise?

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

Incluye dos inmersiones con instructor y equipo; la teoría debe estar terminada antes de la práctica y requiere al menos 4 horas.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
*Desde Cartagena* — lancha desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita · con almuerzo
• Especialidad PADI: Identificación de Peces: 418 USD · 464 USD
• Especialidad PADI: Nitrox: 418 USD · 464 USD
• Especialidad PADI: Naturalista: 418 USD · 464 USD
• Especialidad PADI: Flotabilidad: 418 USD · 464 USD
*Ya en las Islas del Rosario* — recogida en tu hotel si tiene acceso por lancha · sin almuerzo
• Especialidad PADI: Identificación de Peces: 344 USD · 382 USD
• Especialidad PADI: Nitrox: 344 USD · 382 USD
• Especialidad PADI: Naturalista: 344 USD · 382 USD
• Especialidad PADI: Flotabilidad: 344 USD · 382 USD

msg: Buenas! Soy argentino, tengo Advanced de SSI con unas 40 inmersiones. Me interesa bucear con nitrox en las Islas del Rosario. Me sirve mi certificación SSI? Ustedes tienen nitrox?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Las Islas del Rosario son un lugar bacano para bucear con Nitrox.

Tu certificación Advanced de SSI acredita experiencia de buceo, pero para usar los tanques de Nitrox necesitas también una certificación en Nitrox. La teoría debe estar terminada antes de la práctica y requiere al menos 4 horas.

Para participar, presenta tu carné de buzo certificado; puedes mostrarlo el día de la actividad o enviar una foto antes. La edad mínima es 10 años. Después de bucear, espera al menos 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo.

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
*Desde Cartagena* — lancha desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita · con almuerzo
• Especialidad PADI: Identificación de Peces: 418 USD · 464 USD
• Especialidad PADI: Nitrox: 418 USD · 464 USD
• Especialidad PADI: Naturalista: 418 USD · 464 USD
• Especialidad PADI: Flotabilidad: 418 USD · 464 USD
*Ya en las Islas del Rosario* — recogida en tu hotel si tiene acceso por lancha · sin almuerzo
• Especialidad PADI: Identificación de Peces: 344 USD · 382 USD
• Especialidad PADI: Nitrox: 344 USD · 382 USD
• Especialidad PADI: Naturalista: 344 USD · 382 USD
• Especialidad PADI: Flotabilidad: 344 USD · 382 USD

Entonces, ¿ya estarás en las *Islas del Rosario* (salida desde las islas)? 🌴

msg: Hola, buceo con certificación CMAS una estrella y tengo 30 inmersiones. ¿Puedo bucear con ustedes?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Claro que sí! Con tu certificación CMAS puedes hacer salidas de buceo recreativo; debes presentar tu carné, ya sea enviando una foto antes o mostrándolo el día de la actividad. La profundidad máxima depende de lo que permita tu certificación.

También necesitas:
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente.

¿Quieres que te cuente las opciones de buceo y sus precios?

msg: Hola, buceo con certificación CMAS una estrella y tengo 30 inmersiones. ¿Puedo bucear con ustedes?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué bueno que ya tengas experiencia! Para las salidas recreativas necesitas presentar tu carné de buzo certificado; puedes enviarnos una foto antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad. La profundidad máxima depende de la equivalencia de tu certificación CMAS, y eso no aparece en la información que tengo. ¿Quieres que te pase con un asesor para confirmar si tu nivel cumple los requisitos?

También necesitas:
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):

• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD

msg: Hello, we're a family from Toronto staying at Hotel San Pedro de Majagua on the islands. Our kids are 9 and 11. What can they do? We parents would snorkel.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a lovely family plan! Since you’re staying at San Pedro de Majagua, pick-up is included there.

- **Your 9-year-old:** can snorkel or try the **Bubble Makers** program, a first diving experience in a pool or very shallow water (maximum 2 m) with a dedicated PADI instructor. It doesn’t provide certification.
- **Your 11-year-old:** can snorkel, take the **Dive Mini Course**, or start the **Open Water course**. Certified fun dives are also an option if they already hold an Open Water certification.
- **You parents:** the **Snorkeling Tour** is available from age 6. It includes gear, insurance and a PADI professional; there are two reef snorkeling sessions, with pick-up at your hotel between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. and return around 12:00–1:00 p.m. Lunch isn’t included.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD

Would you like the booking link for the snorkeling tour, or details on the kids’ options?

msg: Hola, buenas noches. Somos una pareja de Barranquilla y queremos hacer snorkel el domingo saliendo desde Cartagena. ¿Cuánto cuesta y qué incluye?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

El snorkel en las Islas del Rosario es un plan buenísimo para disfrutar el arrecife desde la superficie. Para ustedes dos, incluye:

- Transporte en lancha ida y vuelta desde Cartagena.
- 2 salidas guiadas con guía local y equipo de snorkel.
- Almuerzo, seguro, entrada al Parque Nacional Natural y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL.

El encuentro es a las 8:00 a. m. en el Muelle de la Bodeguita; el regreso a Cartagena es aproximadamente a las 4:15 p. m. No incluye el transporte terrestre hasta el muelle, fotos o videos ni comida adicional al almuerzo.

Te dejo a continuación el precio y la información para continuar con la reserva.

🤿 *Tour de Snorkeling*
💰 *448.000 COP* por persona · 2 personas

El pago es en pesos colombianos (COP): pueden pagar *100 % online* o un *anticipo del 50 %* con el enlace, el QR o Llave que envía el asesor, y el *otro 50 % el día de la actividad*.

- Dos salidas guiadas, equipo de snorkel y seguro.
- Almuerzo y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL.

msg: Hello, I'm from Hamburg and I'm staying in Bocagrande next week. I'm Open Water certified but my last dive was three years ago. I'd like to dive this Thursday and I fly home on Friday at 10 in the morning. Is that possible, and what would it cost?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes, it’s possible. Since you’re certified and haven’t dived for three years, you’ll need a refresher. The refresher counts as a recreational dive for flying: you must wait at least 18 hours after your last dive. A daytime dive ends around noon–1:00 p.m., so your Friday 10:00 a.m. flight would be too soon.

The refresher is booked as the Dive Mini Course. The online booking includes a 10% discount, applied automatically. You can book here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Would another dive date that leaves at least 18 hours before your flight work for you?

msg: Hello, I'm from Hamburg and I'm staying in Bocagrande next week. I'm Open Water certified but my last dive was three years ago. I'd like to dive this Thursday and I fly home on Friday at 10 in the morning. Is that possible, and what would it cost?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes, Thursday works with your Friday 10:00 a.m. flight, as long as your last dive is a daytime dive. Since you’re certified and it’s been three years, you’ll need a refresher; the flight wait is at least 18 hours from your last dive. Daytime activities end around noon–1:00 p.m., so a Friday flight at 10:00 a.m. is within the safe interval.

The refresher is booked as the Dive Mini Course. The online price includes the automatic 10% discount. You can book here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

The website closes bookings for the next day at 4:30 p.m. the day before.

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Would you like to book the refresher for Thursday?

El precio online es **126 USD o 448.000 COP por persona**. Puedes elegir la fecha y las dos personas aquí: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=es

msg: Buenos días. Mi esposo es buzo Advanced y yo estoy embarazada de cinco meses. Nos alojamos en Cartagena. ¿Puedo acompañarlo en la lancha y hacer snorkel mientras él bucea? ¿Cuánto costaría para los dos?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Con mucho gusto te ayudo con eso. 🌊

Te cuento con calma, porque son dos cosas distintas:

**Sobre el buceo:** durante el embarazo no se bucea con botella —ni minicurso, ni salidas, ni cursos—, así que esa parte no aplica para ti. Pero tranquila, que sí tienes un plan lindo.

**Sobre el snorkel:** el snorkel en superficie sí lo puedes hacer, con el visto bueno de tu médico. Es una experiencia muy chévere: dos salidas guiadas con guía local para disfrutar el arrecife desde arriba, y tu esposo puede bucear con normalidad. En los grupos que combinan buceo y snorkel, el snorkel se hace en una zona distinta a la del buceo, así que cada uno disfruta lo suyo.

Ojo con un detalle: el plan de acompañante (el que va en la lancha sin meterse al agua) es solo para quien no bucea **ni hace snorkel**. Como tú sí vas a hacer snorkel, lo tuyo se reserva como Tour de Snorkeling.

Y sí, van juntos en la lancha desde Cartagena, saliendo del Muelle de la Bodeguita a las 8:00 a.m., con almuerzo incluido y regreso en la tarde.

Te dejo los precios por persona justo aquí abajo 👇

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Tour de Snorkeling: 126 USD · 140 USD (448.000 COP · 497.000 COP)
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 287 USD · 319 USD (1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP)
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)

¿Quieres que te ayude a armar la reserva de los dos?

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish).
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
- From Cartagena: departure at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and return at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.). From the islands: hotel pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (8:00 a.m. for specialties and 7:30 a.m. on day 2 of some courses). Daytime activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m. (see the activity schedule). Night diving: in the evening (pick-up around 5:30 p.m., back around 7:30 p.m.). Online booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you book on the website for the next available day.
- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.
- The tour includes water all day, coconut candy between dives, and lunch (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables). The menu is always the same, it does not change by day/supplier. Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. Any tip to the instructor for photos/videos is voluntary: each guest gives whatever they like, directly to them. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). On overnight courses and packages, day 1's daytime activities also end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., and then you go to your hotel on the islands. Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).
- There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
- You can bring your own camera on the dives or snorkeling, at your own risk. Diving Planet does not rent cameras.

msg: Hi, I'm Advanced and my last dive was 6 months ago. I'd like to dive on Thursday from Cartagena. My flight leaves that same Thursday at 11 pm. Is that OK?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

No—because your flight is the same day, the 18-hour waiting period after recreational diving won’t be met. The wait is counted from your last dive, not from when you return to Cartagena. From Cartagena, the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m., but that return time doesn’t change the required interval.

Would another dive date work for you?

msg: Hi, I'm Advanced and my last dive was 6 months ago. I'd like to dive on Thursday from Cartagena. My flight leaves that same Thursday at 11 pm. Is that OK?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

No—because you’re certified, you need to wait at least 18 hours after your last dive before flying. A daytime dive from Cartagena ends around 12:00–1:00 p.m., so an 11:00 p.m. flight that same day would be too soon. You’d need to fly no earlier than 7:00 a.m. the next day.

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊

Question: How long do I have to wait to fly after diving?
Other ways to ask: Can I fly the same day I dive? / What's the minimum time between diving and flying?
Answer: Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing.

msg: Hi, I'm Advanced and my last dive was 6 months ago. I'd like to dive on Thursday from Cartagena. My flight leaves that same Thursday at 11 pm. Is that OK?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

No—because you’re flying the same day, the required 18-hour wait after recreational diving won’t be met. The wait is counted from your last dive, not from when you return to Cartagena. From Cartagena, the boat returns around 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m., so the 11 p.m. flight is also quite tight.

A daytime dive on Thursday would mean waiting until at least 7:00 a.m. Friday to fly. Would you like help looking at another dive date?

msg: Hi, I'm Advanced, last dive 2 months ago. I want the 3-dive package with the night dive on Thursday from Cartagena. My flight is on Friday at 10 am. Is that OK?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The 3-dive package includes a night dive, so a Friday 10:00 a.m. flight would be too soon: you need to wait at least 18 hours after your last dive, and the wait starts from the night dive itself—not from your return to Cartagena.

This package also requires an overnight stay on the islands. Would you like to consider a daytime-only option instead, or ask a team advisor about a plan that fits your flight?

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish).
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
- From Cartagena: departure at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and return at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.). From the islands: hotel pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (8:00 a.m. for specialties and 7:30 a.m. on day 2 of some courses). Daytime activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m. (see the activity schedule). Night diving: in the evening (pick-up around 5:30 p.m., back around 7:30 p.m.). Online booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you book on the website for the next available day.
- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.
- The tour includes water all day, coconut candy between dives, and lunch (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables). The menu is always the same, it does not change by day/supplier. Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. Any tip to the instructor for photos/videos is voluntary: each guest gives whatever they like, directly to them. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). On overnight courses and packages, day 1's daytime activities also end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., and then you go to your hotel on the islands. Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).
- There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
- You can bring your own camera on the dives or snorkeling, at your own risk. Diving Planet does not rent cameras.

msg: Hi, I'm Advanced, last dive 2 months ago. I want the 3-dive package with the night dive on Thursday from Cartagena. My flight is on Friday at 10 am. Is that OK?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The 3-dive package includes a night dive, so a Friday 10 a.m. flight would be too soon: you need to wait at least 18 hours after your last dive, and the wait starts from the night dive—not from your return to Cartagena.

Also, this package requires an overnight stay on the islands and isn’t a same-day return to Cartagena. Would you like to consider a daytime-only option instead?
